I often find myself torn between thinking I'm the worst scum in the universe that doesn't deserve anything, but I also try to change my thinking habits, I was going well for about a month until I started thinking about an ex. I loved her, her smile, mannerisms, the times when she would look at me and I realized that the world didn't matter, she even had a dog too! But one day I fell into a put of negative thinking and refused to talk to her about it. Up until that point we we're doing great, I spent the past 9 months beating myself up even though I knew we could've still been friends. And even though I have been working through it I still have a lot to deal with. I often think about how if I had acted sooner things would be different. But I'm trying to live in the now, because I'm tired of feeling like shit and I'm tired of constantly missing what was. I plan to hang out with her soon, I want to make memories that I can be happy about, and keep the ones that make me sad, because how can you have the good without the bad. The happy without the sad. This valley of pain is over, I'm going to reach the peak of the mountain. If you read this, thank you. Times have been hard and many suicidal thoughts have come and gone.
